verdict.rationale: An API spec is a fair question for an authentication product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec for Microsoft Authenticator. Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths on the support domain all returned 404, and nothing in the docs mentions a downloadable API definition.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
